claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.quote: would it be safer to wrap the assertions in a `try...finally` block so that the block file is always restored, even if an assertion or unexpected exception causes the test to exit early.
claims.request: Wrap functional test assertions in a try...finally block so the renamed block file is always restored

status_by.quote: I don’t think a finally block is needed here: if an assertion fails, the functional test’s temporary datadir is deleted during teardown, so restoring the renamed file provides no practical benefit.

claims.status_note: maflcko explained teardown deletes the temporary test directory anyway so restoring the file is unnecessary
